request.purpose: Check whether the proposed exact-formulation 7/28-day contrast is estimable in the full table, quantify the prespecified binder-group and common-support counts, and return formulation-level summaries with bootstrap uncertainty. Also report paired absolute strength gain as a descriptive sensitivity diagnostic; no batch-level or causal claim.
request.model_spec: Exact key is the seven supplied ingredient quantities excluding Age and strength. If multiple rows share a formulation-age cell, aggregate strength to its mean and count such cells. Pair only formulations with observed ages 7 and 28. Compare SCM_share=0 with SCM_share>0.30; exclude intermediate shares. Common support is the intersection of the two groups ranges on day-28 MPa and Water/binder ratio, applied as a rectangular range restriction. Report medians of day-7/day-28 strength fraction and 28-minus-7 MPa gain, group counts, and a formulation-resampled percentile interval for the median-ratio difference when both groups have at least two formulations. Do not widen thresholds if support is absent.
